title: Refactor model bootstrapping sequence and shard negotiation
creator: Aisha Patel
description: Goal: Simplify and harden the model bootstrapping path (checkpoint -> weights -> shard map -> tokenizer handshake) to eliminate ordering-dependent bugs, reduce cold-start memory, and provide a clear versioned contract for shard metadata. This ticket refactors the boot sequence into explicit phases and introduces a canonical shard_manifest header format plus a lightweight compatibility shim for older checkpoints.
acceptance_criteria: Loader exposes a stable startBootstrap() -> negotiateShards() -> hydrateWeights() API used by runtime and private deployments
Shard manifest header format v2 is generated for all newly-created checkpoints and readable by legacy checkpoints via shim
Tokenizer no longer performs I/O during core weight hydration; tokenizer integration occurs after shard negotiation with clear contract calls
Cold-start P95 latency reduced or unchanged in all configurations; memory footprint reduced for large-model cold starts when lazy_kv_init is enabled
Automated migration tool exists to upgrade on-disk checkpoints to shard_manifest v2 (best-effort, non-destructive)
All new unit and integration tests added, and CI passes in runtime-1.25 branch
notes: 2026-02-25: Spike showed two root causes: (1) tokenizer open/read during weight mapping caused file descriptor spikes under high parallel loads, (2) some checkpoint producers write inconsistent shard index numbering (0-based vs 1-based) leading to silent mapping bugs.
2026-02-28: Decided to split boot sequence into phases. Prototype implemented a startBootstrap() promise that yields a ShardManifest object; tokenizer handshake moved to post-negotiation stage.

2026-03-03: Introduced shard_manifest v2 header (fields: format_version, layout=[contiguous|interleaved], shard_count, weights_checksum, producer_version). Backwards shim translates common legacy headers to v2 for reads.
2026-03-06: Implemented lazy_kv_init option in loader to avoid allocating KV cache entries until first use. Initial bench shows meaningful memory savings for large models with many unused KV slots.

2026-03-09: Design review with PM/Design/Infra: agreed to keep compatibility shim for at least 3 releases and to surface checksum warnings in Console (non-fatal unless mapping mismatch prevents correct assembly).
2026-03-11: Found regression: eager quantization metadata load caused small latency bump in dedicated bursts; mitigated by deferring quant metadata read until after minimal runtime checks.
2026-03-12: PR opened for loader API and shard_manifest writers; current focus: expand integration tests across on-prem packaging and dedicated GPU pools.
benchmarks: 32B model cold-start P95 before: 4.8s, after (with lazy_kv_init): 4.4s (~8% improvement)
32B model resident memory before: 62GB, after (lazy_kv_init + manifest compacting): 49GB (~21% reduction)
Small models (<=7B) show negligible change in cold-start latency (+/-2%)
risk: Medium. Changes touch low-level loader APIs used by hosted, dedicated, and private flows. Compatibility shim reduces immediate breakage risk but long-term migration steps required. Quant metadata deferral had a small regression that required additional IO scheduling work.
migration_plan: Provide automatic 'upgrade-checkpoint' utility that reads legacy headers and writes shard_manifest v2 as sidecar (non-destructive).
Run upgrade tool on Dedicated pools during maintenance windows; for Private customers, ship tool and runbook.
Mark old manifest read-path as deprecated and schedule removal after three releases (post runtime-1.28).
testing_plan: Integration tests: simulate mixed-version checkpoints across nodes and verify deterministic mapping
End-to-end smoke in staging with canary model rollout (A/B): compare latency/cost and checksum warnings
Fuzz tests for malformed shard headers and inconsistent shard_count
rollback_plan: Revert PRs in serve (3421,3457,3499) and re-enable legacy eager hydrate path. For checkpoints, skip upgrade sidecar step so reads continue using legacy shim. Prepare runbook to restore quant metadata eager load if necessary.
follow_up_tasks: ENG-17005 - telemetry: add shard_manifest format version to model load traces
ENG-17021 - console: surfacing shard checksum warnings in model dashboards
ENG-17110 - private-deploy: include upgrade-checkpoint tool in on-prem bundle
